method: Read official Hosting.com plan and coupon pages in Chrome; opened each plan through its official Choose link and manually read the anonymous checkout basket. Screenshot timestamps were recorded immediately when captured. For a single-plan cart reading, the earlier plan added to this temporary cart was removed before capturing the next one. No login, payment, account quote, domain registration or checkout submission occurred.
